title: Vibetech Database Exposes 13.7M Records Including Assortment of Old Breaches
content_md: Debra Ahmed reports: An unprotected database linked to India-based AI software development and IT services company Vibetech exposed 13.7 million records containing credentials and other sensitive information from previous data breaches.
